input.encoding: raw input bytes in source order

contract.partial_group_padding: one input byte => ==; two input bytes => =
contract.repeat_behavior: The source overwrites the output on each pass; each ABI call returns one stream and the workload repeats calls 1000 times per sample.

pinned_reference_output.meaning: encoded stream byte count printed after the last of 1000 passes over the full upstream input
